fib: ______ is a place where counseling is rendered.
physical setting

communication context

______ is the care of the sick at home given by family members or volunteers, in collaboration with professional health care providers.
Home-based care
Home-based care is the care of the sick at home given by family members or volunteers, in collaboration with professional health care providers.
______ is a test that tells if a person is HIV positive or negative by using a simple blood test or at times making use of saliva or urine.
HIV test
The HIV test is a test that tells if a person is HIV positive or negative by using a simple blood test or at times making use of saliva or urine.
______ is concerned with behaviour change and must involve the application of the principles of learning.
Counselling

Communication

Evaluation

Greeting

universal precautions

______ refers to conducting a review of clients' risk of HIV infection.
Risk assessment

Transference

message
A message is the stimulus which the source or sender transmits to the receiver.
______ is a message received and understood and it is probably our greatest possession.
Information
Information is a message received and understood and it is probably our greatest possession.
______ is a way for the client to ventilate whatever emotion he/she is feeling.
crying

HIV

Behavioural approach for instance
